title: AC1018 and AC1021+ DIMASSOC field projection into the DXF model
scope: Retain known AcDbOsnapPointRef main/intersection fields already modeled for DXF when reading AC1018 inline-string and AC1021+ detached-string DIMASSOC bodies. Preserve strict guards where the single-handle/single-path model cannot represent the source. Record peer/source evidence limits and whole-file output blockers.

sources.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
sources.finding: The local scan did not identify a DIMASSOC object-body field prescription. This receipt does not assert that a synthetic vector is independent evidence for DWG field spans.

sources.title: LibreDWG DWG object grammar
sources.finding: The open-source decoder grammar orders DIMASSOC fields as class TV, osnap type RC, main handle count/vector, optional main subentity/GS marker/XREF path count and strings, near parameter BD and point 3BD, optional intersection handle count/vector/subentity/GS marker/path count and strings, then last-point bit. This agrees with the fields consumed by the updated reader. It is an independent implementation, not normative format authority.

sources.title: LibreDWG 0.14 local reader profile
sources.finding: Independent reader output exposes DIMASSOC records and typed osnap fields for the local AC1021 witness, and decodes 23 DIMASSOC records in the local AC1018 Extruder2 witness. Its successful read establishes reachability and a peer parse only; it does not establish native associative evaluation or this project's output semantics.

implementation.summary: The parser now stores the documented osnap type, main subentity and GS marker, one XREF path, near parameter, WCS point, one intersection handle/subentity/marker/path for intersection types 6 and 11, and last-point flag in the existing DRW_DimensionAssociationOsnapRef model. AC1018 strings are read inline from the object body; AC1021+ strings use the detached string stream. Unknown classes, excess handle/path cardinalities, missing intersection geometry, and out-of-range DXF subentity values keep the record loss-guarded. Generated AC1024 output is checked through ASCII/Binary handle remapping and typed readback. An opt-in physical-source harness resolves each emitted record's local target handles and verifies ASCII/Binary output/readback for 23/23 AC1018 and 6/7 representable AC1021 records. Whole-document strict output remains blocked for both physical samples. Detailed DIMASSOC remains refused by the DWG encoder.
implementation.generatedBytes: The test constructs AC1018 and AC1024 frames from scratch in C++; no DWG/DXF sample file was added.
